A LITTLE ABOUT ME

My full name is Rameshbhai Dipabhai Chaudhary, and many people also know me as Ramesh Kandli. In different family and social contexts, surnames such as Kandli, Chaudhary and Patel may appear. I am 24 years old, from a village in Rah Taluka, Vav–Tharad district, Gujarat, and currently live and work in Vadodara. I have completed Class 12 and work in general office/accounts-related operations at a company. I value honesty, steady learning, practical skills and personal growth.

ABOUT THE MAIN CHARACTER

HELLO, I'M
RAMESH KANDLI.

I’m Rameshbhai Dipabhai Chaudhary, also known as Ramesh Kandli. I’m 24, from Rah Taluka in Vav–Tharad district, Gujarat, and currently working at a company in Vadodara. After completing Class 12, I began building my working experience in general office and accounts-related tasks. I’m interested in learning practical skills, becoming more confident with technology, and growing step by step.

My surname can appear differently in different settings: Kandli is used socially and on some invitations, Chaudhary is used in school-related contexts, and Patel appears in my father’s surname context. This portfolio is my digital space to introduce myself clearly and make professional contact easier.
